crossRefs.note: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.

translations.web: He called one of the servants to him, and asked what was going on.
translations.bsb: So he called one of the servants and asked what was going on.
translations.kjv: And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant.
translations.asv: And he called to him one of the servants, and inquired what these things might be.
